description: I'm Checo Cadena, a Mexican musician and sound artist based in New York. I build interactive pieces that turn data into sound. I'm entering The Earth Information Jukebox challenge as a solo team with Earth Jukebox, an arcade machine in the browser that plays NASA's animations of the Earth as sound. My background is songwriting, sound design, Web Audio and creative coding (NYU, Berklee NYC). The project is finished, so I'm not looking for team members.
